sql:
SELECT boat, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt) AS yt, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),3) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM trips WHERE cls='three_quarter'
GROUP BY boat HAVING SUM(anglers) > 100
ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT cls, boat, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt) AS yt, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),3) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM trips WHERE cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY cls, boat HAVING SUM(anglers) > 50
ORDER BY cls, rate DESC LIMIT 20

summary: Boat choice now picks the scheduled boat with the best historical yt/angler rate for that class (computed from observed trips, min sample size) instead of just the most recently active one.
